name: WCC CF7 to Lawmatics
author: WeConnectCode

sections.description:
Contact Form 7 Lawmatics Plugin sends form submissions from Contact Form 7 plugins to Lawmatics when someone submits a form. Learn more about Contact Form 7 Lawmatics Plugin at weconnectcode.com. We also offer other connector for Clio Contact Form 7 Clio Integration.

License

GPLv2 or later

How to Setup

  • Go to “Lawmatics Accounts” tab then add new account.
  • Go to “Lawmatics Integration” tab then create new Integration.
  • Map required Lawmatics fields to contact form 7 fields.
  • Send your test entry to Lawmatics by submiting contact form 7.
  • Go to “Lawmatics Logs” tab and verify, if entry was sent to Lawmatics.

Connect Lawmatics account

Connect any contact form 7 to Lawmatics account by safe and secure Oauth 2.0.

Map Lawmatics fields

First select any Lawmatics object then Map contact form fields to Lawmatics object fields. There is No limitation on number of fields. You can map unlimited fields.

Filter contact form 7 submissions

Either Send all contact form 7 submissions to Lawmatics or filter contact form submissions sent to Lawmatics based on user input. For example , send only those entries to Lawmatics which have work email address.

Manually send to Lawmatics

Send contact form 7 submissions to Lawmatics when someone submits a contact form. You can manually send contact form submissions to Lawmatics.

Lawmatics logs

View a detailed log of each contact form 7 submission whether sent (or not sent) to Lawmatics and easily resend any contact form submission to Lawmatics.

Send Data As Lawmatics object Notes

Send one to many contact form fields as Lawmatics object notes when anyone submits a form on your site.

Why we built this plugin

Contact Form 7 and some other popular contact forms are good but you can not send contact form submissions to any crm including Lawmatics. You can send any contact form submissions from your wordpress site to Lawmatics with this free wordpress Lawmatics plugin.

Premium Version Features.

This plugin has a Premium version which comes with several additional benifits Contact Form 7 – Lawmatics.

  • Lawmatics Custom fields and Particularly Phone Fields.
  • Lawmatics Notes Field
  • User Agent and IP related Data Of the Entries
  • WCC Entries Pro Version With all the Premium Features.
  • Super Helpful WCC Addons and Free Updates.
  • By Purchasing the Premium Version of the Plugin, You will Get Free Updates
  • Get Pro Support

sections.faq:
Where can I get support?

Our team provides free support at https://weconnectcode.com/contact.

How to integrate Lawmatics in contact form 7

You can easily integrate Lawmatics in contact form 7. Simply install Contact Form 7 Lawmatics plugin , Connect Lawmatics account and finally map contact form fields to Lawmatics object(contact,lead,account etc) fields.

Contact form 7 Lawmatics web to lead

if API access is not enabled for your organization then simply use Lawmatics web to lead. Enter your organization id and map contact form fields to Lawmatics case or lead fields.

WordPress Lawmatics Integration

  • You can use Contact Form 7 or any other wordpress forms plugin.
  • Install this free WordPress Lawmatics Integration plugin then Connect your Lawmatics account to wordpress.
  • Create a Lawmatics Integration , select form then map form fields to Lawmatics Object(Lead, account etc) fields.
  • When anyone submits form , it will go to your Lawmatics account.

Lawmatics WordPress Plugin

  • Easily Connect your Lawmatics account to wordpress site with this free wordpress Lawmatics plugin.
  • First Install Contact Form 7 plugin and create a simple form.
  • Connect Lawmatics account to wordpress.
  • Create a Lawmatics Integration then map contact form fields to Lawmatics object(lead, contact etc) fields.
  • All form submissions will automatically go to your Lawmatics account.

External services

This plugin integrates with the Lawmatics platform. When a user submits a form using Contact Form 7, their data is sent to Lawmatics via their API.

Details:
Service Name: Lawmatics
Purpose: To capture and manage inquiries submitted via Contact Form 7 in the Lawmatics CRM for efficient client management and follow-ups.
Data Sent: Form submission data, including (but not limited to) user-provided name, email, phone number, and message content.
Endpoint: Data is sent securely to the Lawmatics API endpoint.

API Endpoints Used:
    Authorization Endpoint: https://app.lawmatics.com/oauth/authorize
    Token Endpoint: https://api.lawmatics.com/oauth/token
    API Base URL: https://api.lawmatics.com/v1/

Privacy and Terms:
    <a href="https://www.lawmatics.com/terms-of-use/">Lawmatics Terms of Service</
    <a href="https://www.lawmatics.com/privacy-policy/">Lawmatics Privacy Policy</
